body.contents: Season I opens Saturday 7 November at 5 PM Pacific (8 PM Eastern): the launch hour, then PvP and the Nether open at 6 PM. The Build Battle wheel spins at 5 PM, and judging is Sunday 8 November at 6 PM.
Next week: Faction Raid I, Saturday 14 November.
Every event is in the Discord's events list: press Interested there for a reminder. New challenges every Monday.
Outpost sieges, Wednesday 7 to 9 PM and Sunday 3 to 5 PM Pacific: capture an outpost while one is on for a bonus hour held. Claims stay protected. /trigger sieges says if one is on.
